doc.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dating his first full Broadway production
summary: He tries to date Beggar's Holiday, Bravo Giovanni and Flower Drum Song.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Give me a date of maybe your first full Broadway production.
First full Broadway production. Date? (laughs) He says dates?
Okay, let's see. Now let's go back. It would have had to have been after the first Ellington concert, the Carnegie thing. The Carnegie thing was in 1955, I think. So

that I would say that … Beggar's Holiday was the absolute first one. And I think that that was like 1959, in that area. And soon after that, the next thing I believe that was actually Broadway was I think Bravo Giovanni. It was either Bravo Giovanni or Flower Drum Song. That was like early '60s, I guess.
